_comment: Maps a Google Business Profile location to the Mezza Location_Name the sales feed uses. Google's own titles are almost all just 'Mezza Lebanese Kitchen' -- six of them in Halifax alone -- so the title is useless as a key and byTitle is left empty on purpose. These were matched on STREET ADDRESS, cross-checked against the Push Operations company labels (which are addresses) and store-mapping.json.
_note_two_accounts: Every location is reachable through two accounts: one organisation account holding all 23, plus a per-location account per store. The sync deduplicates on the location id; without that, every metric was counted twice.

excludeLocationIds.12151035443143094217: Production Centre, 63 Jim Connors Ave -- the 15,000 sq ft plant, not a customer-facing store. Its Google listing is real but it has no sales in the POS feed, so joining it to a store row would be wrong.

_UNRESOLVED.7866692448696251318: 6136 University Ave, Halifax. This is the ONE location I will not guess. By arithmetic it must be 'Larry Uteck' -- that is the only Location_Name in the sales feed left unmapped, and this is the only Google location left over. But Larry Uteck Blvd is in Bedford and 6136 University Ave is in Halifax near Dalhousie, so geographically they are not the same place. Either the POS name is legacy, or Larry Uteck has no Google listing and this is a store the POS calls something else. Peter to confirm; guessing is how one store's reviews end up filed against another.
